Title: Address points [Michigan--Ann Arbor] {2026}
Description: Historical dataset of Address points in Ann Arbor, Michigan as of 2026. Representation of PIN and address information tied to each basic land ownership unit or sub-unit within the jurisdiction of the City of Ann Arbor. Included also are other properties which are subject to possible annexation and/or provided with City services requiring payment or regulation. Points were originally generated from parcel centroids combined with PIN and address attributes and supplemented by manual addition of condominium and apartment addresses from the Address Table, Community Services staff maintains the graphic and attribute information for accuracy and consistency to use with other City mapping applications. Points are spatially adjusted as needed.

Title: Building footprints [Michigan--Ann Arbor] {2026}
Description: Historical dataset of Building footprints in Ann Arbor, Michigan as of 2026. The building outline dataset for the City of Ann Arbor. Includes the average height of the structure. Woolpert completed a semi-automated method for building generation utilizing new countywide 2009 LiDAR data and existing 2005-2008 orthoimagery. Buildings over 100 square feet were generated and run through a QC process. The final building polygons were developed for the entire ±709-square mile county area. The dataset has had all but those footprints near or within the City of Ann Arbor and contains an average building height. Updates are currently done with new construction plans and then verified using the newest aerial imagery.
